DECOMPOSED net +5 England (m96 lesson): tactical_stylistic_matchup +10 home (ENG aerial/cross attack: 4 headed goals co-lead, Kane 3 most, 4.4 headed shots/match, 3 left-wing cross goals, 56.7% aerial -- onto ARG documented cross/counter concessions: both Egypt goals cross-finished incl. back-post header over L.Martinez, ESPN-flagged, 5-of-9 SOT against converted) + injury_replacement 5 away (Rice unresolved after HT withdrawal vs Norway; Guehi/James managed; Quansah ban zero marginal delta; amend triggers registered both directions). DECLINED: fatigue asymmetry (offsetting, ledger 0.5-for-2), Argentina results-inflation story (m99-banned family, usable only as gap explanation), Kane finisher premium (symmetric with Messi), tempo (neither side bunkers by plan). pk_h 0.45 Dibu shootout premium (qualify layer only, m100 precedent). | FULFILLMENT AUDIT (2026-07-16, process not outcome): tactical_stylistic_matchup materialized INVERTED -- the aerial/cross mechanism was real and decisive, but Argentina won it, not England: winner was Messi cross -> Lautaro header (90+2'), plus Mac Allister header off the post (76') and a Nico Gonzalez header save (69'); England recorded zero headed shots and Kane (the named player) had 26 touches/1 shot/0 SoT/0.02 xG. Tuchel post-match, verbatim: 'They won every header. They kept crossing and crossing. So we went to a back five...' (Al Jazeera 2026-07-15) -- the switch conceded again 3 minutes later. injury_replacement did NOT manifest as a limiting factor: Rice started, played to 82' (Sofascore 7.1, 2 key passes, 1 SoT), substituted as part of a tactical back-five switch alongside James, not an injury withdrawal; both England concessions came after he was already off. Net: the direction J leaned away from (Argentina) still won, but via the exact mechanism J bet the OTHER way on -- a genuine mechanism-level miss that happened not to flip the RPS verdict, since M/J both still beat market comfortably on this outcome. Full detail: verdicts_main.md m102 Phase 4.

DECOMPOSED net -3 England-ward (m96 lesson): rest_travel +3 France (England 3 vs France 4 rest days, Tuchel confirmed on record; England's QF went 120min vs France's 90min two days earlier) + incentive_rotation -4 France (07-16 French-press heavy-rotation consensus -- Kante/L.Hernandez/Gusto/Zaire-Emery/Cherki minutes, Olise/Dembele fatigue-flagged -- vs England's predicted near-full XI; size capped by Mbappe's Golden Boot incentive, tied 8 with Messi on the assists tiebreaker, third-place goals count; first use of this mechanism type, added to the taxonomy 2026-07-17) + injury_replacement -2 France (Saliba confirmed OUT, surgery pending; CB depth Konate/Upamecano/Lacroix blunts it to the smallest size class). DECLINED: standalone France morale-collapse (single-source, two-sided against Deschamps' farewell-motivation counter-narrative), Deschamps farewell bonus (the flattering mirror of the same story, declined on the two-sidedness check), James absence (unofficial, replacement Spence performing well), bronze-match openness base rate (market-known, no j.lambdas field to carry it), semifinal-form (both sides poor, already in Elo, m99-banned-family symmetric), Miami heat/storms (symmetric). pk_h 0.5 (neither keeper carries a Dibu-class shootout record). Pre-registered T-75 action tree (Bellingham ban +8, Mbappe absence -4, Kane absence +4, lineup-change-count thresholds) per verdicts_main.md m103 section. MATERIALIZATION AUDIT (2026-07-20 settle, England 6-4 in 90', xG ENG 3.05 - FRA 2.80): rest_travel +3 FRA did NOT materialize -- England, with one day less rest and a 120-minute QF in their legs, blitzed France 0-4 by half-time (shots 11-5, SoT 7-2); direction opposite, project record for this type now 1-of-3-ish and still weak. incentive_rotation -4 FRA: premise half-wrong but substance materialized -- the registered asymmetry (France rotates, England near-full) was factually wrong by kickoff (England changed 7 vs France's 6 counted), yet the France-side substance (flat, demoralized, heavily-rotated France collapsing to a B-XI) is exactly what the pitch showed; the tier-3 single-source demoralization report ('disgusted to have to play', already planning vacations) that the rules correctly down-weighted turned out to be the single most predictive item in the bundle -- recorded as a known cost of the source-tier discipline, not a rule failure. Mbappe magnitude-cap vindicated precisely: he started despite the rotation, scored twice, took the Golden Boot 10-8. injury_replacement -2 FRA (Saliba): direction-consistent (6 conceded through a fully-rotated backline) but not cleanly attributable to the Saliba loss specifically since the entire defense was rotated anyway. NET -3 England-ward: direction correct (England won), magnitude trivially small vs a 10-goal blowout -- but per doctrine the audit scores mechanism materialization, not outcome distance. Full detail: results.json m103 notes + verdicts_main.md m103 Phase 4.

DECOMPOSED net +1 Spain from two offsetting factors (m96 lesson: no undecomposed bundles): tactical_stylistic_matchup -4 Argentina (tournament-leading set-piece output -- 5 set-piece goals vs 2 at WC2022 -- onto Spain's only tournament goal conceded, a crossed header vs Belgium; Spain side thin, n=1, vs a historic-low 0.31 xGA/match; magnitude deliberately below the m100/m102 +10 class, and self-flagged 0/2 J-better precedent for this mechanism type in the project's own ledger, r32_esp_aut and m102 both materialized inverted or ineffectively) + rest_travel +5 Spain (Argentina 4 rest days vs Spain's 5, plus two extra-time knockout matches -- Cape Verde R16, Switzerland QF -- vs zero for Spain; Messi, 39, played every minute of the semifinal and looked fatigued late; partly offset by Spain's longer travel leg). DECLINED: Messi finisher-premium (career-anchoring precedent required, bundle only sourced tournament-level figures; Spain's mirror-image xG underperformance is equally public and declining both avoids regression-to-mean speculation the market already prices), Argentina flank-vulnerability-vs-Yamal (bundle self-flagged 'no source directly stated this', shares the wide/cross theme with factor 1 -- would double-count one underlying structure, declined on anchoring discipline), tempo (no confirmed low-block formation, no anchored evidence), Argentina-Elo-results-inflation (m99-banned family, gap-explanation only). qualify layer pk_h 0.45 (Martinez undefeated across four international shootouts vs Simon's ~26% career shootout save rate near GK base rate; same magnitude as m100/m102 by design, to avoid evidence-reuse inflation across matches). Pre-registered T-75 action tree (Yamal absence -10 Argentina, Messi absence +10 Spain, other key-player absences +/-5) per verdicts_main.md m104 section. MATERIALIZATION AUDIT (2026-07-20 settle, Spain 1-0 AET, 0-0 at 90', xG ESP 1.94 - ARG 0.20): tactical_stylistic_matchup -4 ARG (set-piece threat onto Spain's single aerial concession) did NOT materialize -- Argentina produced 2 shots and 0.20 xG in 120 minutes with no recorded set-piece threat; this mechanism type is now 0-for-3 in this project's ledger (r32_esp_aut, m102, m104), the single worst-performing mechanism type on the books, and the m104 lock's own self-flag (0/2 precedent, deliberately sub-m100-class magnitude) was the right instinct. rest_travel +5 ESP (two prior ETs + one fewer rest day for Argentina) materialized in DIRECTION -- Argentina visibly gassed, dragged to a third extra time, conceded at 106' -- but is confounded by Enzo Fernandez's 90'+ red card (Argentina played all of ET with 10), so recorded as direction-consistent-with-confound, not clean; type record now roughly 2-of-4 with confounds, still below MIN_N=5. pk_h=0.45 (Dibu shootout premium, qualify layer): untested AGAIN (no shootout) -- registered three times in this project (m100/m102/m104), tested zero times. NET +1 Spain-ward vs a process gap of 1.94-0.20: direction right, magnitude homeopathic -- J's own 'two-sided evidence, stay near M' restraint was defensible ex ante, but the settle fact is that the market's larger Spain-lean was the better read of the football even though M=J still edged it on 90' RPS via the draw. Full detail: results.json m104 notes + verdicts_main.md m104 Phase 4.
